records.query: Need the patient's detailed ophthalmology consultation records, including slit-lamp examination for posterior subcapsular cataract and OCT for macular thickening, plus serial visual acuity assessments to confirm the delayed onset and rule out alternative causes.
records.text: Spectral-domain OCT findings:- Initial examination (4 days post-injury):   Image Description: Preserved foveal contour in both eyes without cystoid abnormalities. Right eye showed subtle irregularity of the outer retinal layers, most notable nasal to the fovea  - Two weeks post-injury:  Image Description: Intraretinal cystoid changes and subfoveal ellipsoid zone disruption in the right eye  - Seven weeks post-injury:  Image Description: Restoration of foveal contour with decreased cystoid abnormalities, small subfoveal hyporeflective space, and further loss of outer retinal layers in the nasal macula  - Four months post-injury:  Image Description: Persistent subfoveal hyporeflective space in the inner retina with interval restoration of subfoveal outer retinal structures.

records.query: Need the patient's serial slit-lamp examination reports documenting posterior subcapsular cataract progression, along with repeated visual acuity measurements and any electroretinogram results, to confirm the electrical injury pattern and definitively exclude alternative etiologies.

bindings.label: Decreased vision in the right eye, symptom onset 4 days prior to presentation
A white woman in her 20s with unremarkable medical and ocular history was struck by lightning directly to the right forehead while hiking 4 days before presentation

Initial examination showed uncorrected visual acuity of 20/50 OD and 20/20 OS, symmetric pupils with no relative afferent pupillary defect, normal anterior segment with no cataract, and no apparent abnormalities on dilated fundus examination in either eye
Follow-up at 2 weeks revealed central macular thickening on fundus examination; at 7 weeks, a mild posterior subcapsular cataract was visible in the right eye
OCT at two weeks shows right macular thickening and outer retinal disruption; at four months shows partial restoration
Slit-lamp examination and ERG were not performed; posterior subcapsular cataract not independently verified
